name: Midjourney
shortDescription: Image generation from a text prompt. The plans on their site are paid subscriptions.
longDescription: Midjourney generates images. The plan comparison lists Basic at $10, Standard at $30, Pro at $60, and Mega at $120 per month, and no free plan. Those figures are from the October 15, 2026 docs article.
pricingNotes: No free tier on the official plan chart.
bestFor: Image generation when a paid subscription is acceptable
notIdealFor: A free tier, which the official comparison does not list
strength: The plan comparison lists Basic at $10, Standard at $30, Pro at $60, and Mega at $120 per month.
weakness: That official plan comparison lists no free plan, so every listed plan is a paid subscription.
problems: No free tier on the official plan chart.

useCaseFit.make-images: Draws images from a text prompt.
